scope: Isolated borrowed portfolio/cohort accounting pilot v2; main engines unchanged.
period: 120 project months, actual October 2014-October 2024 dates; full underlying main backtest unchanged.
portfolio_flow: Net same-event cash flow, current mixture and effective leverage before trade costs. Execute proportional trades; finance actual trade expenses with debt. Resulting leverage drift feeds original next-signal rule.
pricing: Units quoted after fund fee and before flow trade expenses; remaining units bear trade expenses. No dilution levy/swing pricing.
fee: Monthly proposed fund fee on previous event opening-equity base. Debt-funded at borrowed exposure; cost-inclusive proportional sale at unlevered exposure.
signals: Original mark/funding/prior-signal trades retained; fees and flows before next signal. No-flow/zero-added-fee history/events exact.
reporting: 24 coupled cases include two zero-added-fee controls and duplicate no-flow layers. 22 overlay cases are labeled diagnostics, not unique portfolio scenarios.
proposal_deviation: Exact post-cost leverage preservation is not well-defined at discontinuous commission tiers; v2 uses explicit cost posting. The unchanged original proposal and failed pilot outputs are preserved.
numerical_evidence: Original fixed point oscillated between USD293.246172 and USD355.233584 for a USD35,603.321803 net flow at leverage1.199236170. No fee/rate/return parameter adjusted.
validation_scope: Primary leverage1.25; positive-debt flow execution. Unlevered paid flow trades are outside this pilot.
